name: Project Kanban
description: A per-project, multi-agent kanban: give a project a brief and member agents, split it into issues, and let several agents work on it in parallel, each through its own queue.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 按项目组织的多智能体看板：为项目设定简介和成员智能体，拆分任务并指派给成员，多个智能体各自排队、并行推进同一个项目。
description_i18n.en-US: A per-project, multi-agent kanban: give a project a brief and member agents, split it into issues, and let several agents work on it in parallel, each through its own queue.

author: QwenPaw Team
